HomePage.title: Image Format Converter
HomePage.subtitle: Convert and compress images entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded
HomePage.upload_prompt: Click or drag and drop an image here

CropPage.title: Image Cropper
CropPage.upload_prompt: Click or drag and drop an image here to start cropping
CropPage.hint: Drag on the image to draw a new selection, drag the box to move it, drag corners or edges to resize. Focus the box and use arrow keys to nudge by 1 px (Shift: 10 px, Alt+arrow to resize).
CropPage.precision_note: X / Y are the top-left coordinates. Type a value and press Enter or leave the field to apply. With a locked ratio the other axis follows automatically.
